description: Obviously synthetic canonical participant on the subsection (2)(a) vacation limb, pre-1 July 1984 offence. Protected/outside-party fields stay blank; the court's discretion and the RCW 9.94A.640(2) tests are matters put to the court, never asserted as satisfied.

chargeData.disposition: Convicted following a plea of guilty; placed on probation

eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisLabel: Vacation of the record of a conviction for an offence committed before 1 July 1984, under RCW 9.95.240(2)(a), the period of probation having expired
eligibilityData.waitingPeriodText: The period of probation imposed in this matter has expired.
additionalFacts: The offence identified above was committed before 1 July 1984, so the tests under RCW 9.94A.640(2) fall to be applied as they would be applied to a person convicted of a crime committed before that date.
Defendant applies to this Court, as the sentencing court, for vacation of the record of conviction, and asks the Court to consider whether the equivalent of the RCW 9.94A.640(2) tests is met.
Defendant states the circumstances relied on in the accompanying statement; that statement is completed by Defendant and is not supplied by any other person.

attachments: Proposed order vacating the record of conviction
Certified copy of the judgment and sentence
Proof that the period of probation has expired
